Anr on 16 May, 2024
16.05.2024 Serial no.1 Aloke Crr 331 of 2022 with Ia No. Cran 4 of 2023 Babu Halder @
Monbhulo Halder Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.

Mr. Prabir Majumder Mr. Debraj Shil ... for the petitioner Mr. Imran Ali Mr. Md. Kutubuddin ... for
the State

The present revisional application has been preferred for quashing of the proceedings in connection with Nakashipara P.S. Case No. 429 dated August 28, 2020 under Sections 376/417/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1991 of 2021 wherein charge-sheet has been submitted vide charge-sheet no. 292 dated June 28, 2021 under Sections 376/417 of the Indian Penal Code, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Krishnanagar at Nadia.

entities.text:
Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Krishnanagar at Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
A written instruction has been placed by the learned counsel for the petitioner wherein the petitioner has stated that he is not willing to proceed with the present criminal revision and, as such,
has prayed for withdrawal of the same.
Let the written instruction be kept with the record.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the materials on record, the present revisional application is thus disposed of as 'withdrawn'.
All connected applications, if any, stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
